title: Waltz Time Bedspread Pattern #6017
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #151 Bedspreads (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Starting at center, ch 8, join with sl st." replaced by magic ring. Block only (rnds 1-24); sewing blocks, edging and fringe omitted. Original heading "14th to 17th rnds incl:" written as "Round 14-17:". Circle of tr/sc/dc rounds squared in rnd 6 with dc-dtr corners, then lacet-and-bar filet-like mesh with solid dc corner blocks that are repeated outward. pattern.dsl left EMPTY: rnds 13-17 are given only as 'continue thus ... working corner pattern as before', so the exact stitch sequence of those rounds isn't spelled out; a DSL would have to invent it.
